CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.compute_daily_features_equity_patch_v3(p_lo integer, p_hi integer, p_start date DEFAULT '2025-09-01'::date, p_end date DEFAULT '2026-07-31'::date)
 RETURNS SETOF market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_daily_features_remediated_v1
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
WITH daily_input AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM market_governance.equity_daily_inputs_v3 WHERE instrument_key BETWEEN p_lo AND p_hi), calendar AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT session_date,regular_open,regular_close FROM market_governance.us_equity_fixed_session_calendar
 WHERE session_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND p_end
 UNION ALL SELECT session_date,regular_open,regular_close FROM market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.precursor_warmup_calendar_v6
 WHERE session_date<'2025-09-01'
), cal AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT *,lag(session_date)OVER(ORDER BY session_date) previous_session_date FROM calendar
), scope AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT instrument_key FROM reference.alpaca_fixed_window_instruments_v1
 WHERE instrument_key BETWEEN p_lo AND p_hi AND p_hi>=p_lo AND p_hi-p_lo<=99
), actions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT instrument_key,execution_date,ratio_new_per_old,ratio_known_at,quality_state
 FROM market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.executed_split_ledger_remediated_v1 WHERE instrument_key BETWEEN p_lo AND p_hi
), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT u.instrument_key,c.session_date,c.regular_close,
 ((extract(epoch FROM c.regular_close-c.regular_open))/60)::smallint expected_bars,
 CASE WHEN d.instrument_key IS NOT NULL OR p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE d.source_code END ELSE 0 END::smallint source_code,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.bar_count WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.bar_count ELSE d.bar_count END::smallint observed_bars,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.close WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.close ELSE d.close END raw_close,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.volume WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.volume ELSE d.volume END raw_volume,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.dollar_volume WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.dollar_volume ELSE d.dollar_volume END dollar_volume,
 greatest(d.source_observed_at,p.source_observed_at,w.source_observed_at,ir.source_acquired_at) source_observed_at,
 (p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL AND p.source_coverage_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'AVAILABLE') patch_unavailable,
 coalesce(d.instrument_key IS NOT NULL OR p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL OR w.instrument_key IS NOT NULL,false) source_present,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' AND w.identity_state='CERTIFIED_EXACT_DATE_COMPOSITE_FIGI'
      THEN coalesce(nullif(w.provenance->>'share_class_figi',''),nullif(w.provenance->>'immutable_composite_figi',''))
      WHEN ir.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(nullif(ir.share_class_figi,''),nullif(ir.composite_figi,''))
      WHEN r.identity_certification_state='CERTIFIED_EXACT_DATE_COMPOSITE_AND_SHARE_FIGI_NATIVE_SOURCE_RECONCILED_V8'
      THEN coalesce(nullif(r.share_class_figi,''),nullif(r.composite_figi,''))
      WHEN st.n=1 AND st.strength='STRONG' THEN coalesce(nullif(st.share_class_figi,''),nullif(st.composite_figi,'')) END identity_anchor,
 coalesce(st.n,0)>1 identity_ambiguous,
 coalesce(a.split_log,0) split_log,coalesce(a.unknown_actions,0) unknown_actions,a.latest_knowledge
 FROM scope u CROSS JOIN cal c
 LEFT JOIN daily_input d ON d.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND d.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_daily_calendar_patch_v8 p ON p.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND p.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_warmup_state_v38 w ON c.session_date<'2025-09-01' AND w.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND w.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN reference.equity_identity_day_overrides_remediation_v1 ir ON ir.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND ir.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.precursor_identity_day_reconciliation_v8 r ON r.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND r.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*)::int n,min(s.mapping_strength) strength,min(s.share_class_figi) share_class_figi,min(s.composite_figi) composite_figi
  FROM reference.equity_security_state_v1 s WHERE s.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND c.session_date>=s.valid_from AND c.session_date<s.valid_to)st ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT sum(ln(a.ratio_new_per_old::float8)) FILTER(WHERE a.ratio_new_per_old>0 AND a.ratio_new_per_old<1e20) split_log,
  count(*)FILTER(WHERE a.ratio_new_per_old IS NULL OR a.ratio_new_per_old<=0 OR a.ratio_new_per_old>=1e20 OR a.ratio_known_at IS NULL OR a.quality_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'PRIMARY_SHARE_REBASING_SEMANTICS_VERIFIED') unknown_actions,
  max(a.ratio_known_at)latest_knowledge
  FROM actions a WHERE a.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND a.execution_date>coalesce(c.previous_session_date,c.session_date-1) AND a.execution_date<=c.session_date)a ON true
), normalized AS (
 SELECT *,sum(split_log)OVER(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date) prefix_split_log,
 (market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(raw_close)AND raw_close>0 AND NOT patch_unavailable) close_valid,
 (raw_volume>=0 AND NOT patch_unavailable) volume_valid
 FROM raw
), prices AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN close_valid AND abs(prefix_split_log)<300 THEN raw_close*exp(prefix_split_log)END adjusted_close_candidate,
 CASE WHEN volume_valid AND abs(prefix_split_log)<300 THEN raw_volume/exp(prefix_split_log)END adjusted_volume_candidate
 FROM normalized
), daily AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN close_valid AND lag(close_valid)OVER wi THEN raw_close/lag(raw_close)OVER wi-1 END raw_return,
 CASE WHEN adjusted_close_candidate>0 AND lag(adjusted_close_candidate)OVER wi>0 THEN ln(adjusted_close_candidate/lag(adjusted_close_candidate)OVER wi)END adjusted_log_return
 FROM prices WINDOW wi AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date)
), stats AS (
 SELECT *,
 count(raw_close)FILTER(WHERE close_valid AND identity_anchor IS NOT NULL)OVER w2 valid_1,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER w2 min_id_1,max(identity_anchor)OVER w2 max_id_1,
 lag(adjusted_close_candidate,1)OVER wi lag_1,
 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e1 unknown_1,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e1 known_1,
 count(raw_close)FILTER(WHERE close_valid AND identity_anchor IS NOT NULL)OVER w6 valid_5,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER w6 min_id_5,max(identity_anchor)OVER w6 max_id_5,
 lag(adjusted_close_candidate,5)OVER wi lag_5,
 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e5 unknown_5,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e5 known_5,
 count(raw_close)FILTER(WHERE close_valid AND identity_anchor IS NOT NULL)OVER w21 valid_20,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER w21 min_id_20,max(identity_anchor)OVER w21 max_id_20,
 lag(adjusted_close_candidate,20)OVER wi lag_20,
 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e20 unknown_20,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e20 known_20,
 count(raw_close)FILTER(WHERE close_valid AND identity_anchor IS NOT NULL)OVER w61 valid_60,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER w61 min_id_60,max(identity_anchor)OVER w61 max_id_60,
 lag(adjusted_close_candidate,60)OVER wi lag_60,
 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e60 unknown_60,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e60 known_60,
 max(source_observed_at)OVER w61 dependency_observed_at,
 count(adjusted_log_return)OVER e20 log_count_20,stddev_samp(adjusted_log_return)OVER e20 vol_20,
 count(adjusted_volume_candidate)OVER v20 volume_count_20,
 avg(adjusted_volume_candidate)OVER v20 mean_volume_20,stddev_samp(adjusted_volume_candidate)OVER v20 sd_volume_20,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER v20 min_id_v20,max(identity_anchor)OVER v20 max_id_v20,
 count(identity_anchor)OVER v20 id_count_v20,
 count(dollar_volume)FILTER(WHERE dollar_volume>0 AND dollar_volume<'Infinity'::float8 AND adjusted_log_return IS NOT NULL)OVER e20 dollar_count_20,
 avg(abs(exp(adjusted_log_return)-1)/nullif(dollar_volume,0))FILTER(WHERE dollar_volume>0 AND dollar_volume<'Infinity'::float8)OVER e20 amihud_20
 FROM daily WINDOW wi AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date),
w2 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e1 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 0 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w6 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e5 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w21 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e20 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w61 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e60 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
v20 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
), eligible AS (
 SELECT *,regular_close+interval '1 minute' assumed_available_at,
 (valid_1=2 AND min_id_1=max_id_1 AND unknown_1=0 AND coalesce(known_1<=regular_close+interval '1 minute',true)AND lag_1>0) ok_1,
 (valid_5=6 AND min_id_5=max_id_5 AND unknown_5=0 AND coalesce(known_5<=regular_close+interval '1 minute',true)AND lag_5>0) ok_5,
 (valid_20=21 AND min_id_20=max_id_20 AND unknown_20=0 AND coalesce(known_20<=regular_close+interval '1 minute',true)AND lag_20>0) ok_20,
 (valid_60=61 AND min_id_60=max_id_60 AND unknown_60=0 AND coalesce(known_60<=regular_close+interval '1 minute',true)AND lag_60>0) ok_60,
 (volume_valid AND adjusted_volume_candidate IS NOT NULL AND volume_count_20=20 AND id_count_v20=20 AND min_id_v20=max_id_v20 AND identity_anchor=min_id_v20 AND unknown_20=0 AND coalesce(known_20<=regular_close+interval '1 minute',true)) ok_volume
 FROM stats
)
SELECT instrument_key,session_date,source_code,observed_bars,expected_bars,
 ((CASE WHEN NOT source_present THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)+(CASE WHEN source_present AND NOT close_valid THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN identity_anchor IS NULL THEN 4 ELSE 0 END)+(CASE WHEN identity_ambiguous THEN 8 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN source_present AND observed_bars<expected_bars THEN 16 ELSE 0 END)+32+64+
 (CASE WHEN valid_60<61 THEN 128 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN unknown_1>0 OR known_1>assumed_available_at THEN 256 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN unknown_5>0 OR known_5>assumed_available_at THEN 512 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN unknown_20>0 OR known_20>assumed_available_at THEN 1024 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN unknown_60>0 OR known_60>assumed_available_at THEN 2048 ELSE 0 END)+4096+16384+
 (CASE WHEN patch_unavailable THEN 8192 ELSE 0 END))::int quality_flags,
 identity_anchor,raw_close,raw_volume,dollar_volume,dependency_observed_at,assumed_available_at,
 raw_return,
 CASE WHEN ok_1 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_1-1 END ret_1d,
 CASE WHEN ok_5 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_5-1 END ret_5d,
 CASE WHEN ok_20 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_20-1 END ret_20d,
 CASE WHEN ok_60 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_60-1 END ret_60d,
 CASE WHEN ok_20 AND log_count_20=20 THEN vol_20 END realized_log_vol_20d,
 CASE WHEN ok_volume AND mean_volume_20>0 THEN adjusted_volume_candidate/mean_volume_20 END relative_volume_20d,
 CASE WHEN ok_volume AND sd_volume_20>0 THEN (adjusted_volume_candidate-mean_volume_20)/sd_volume_20 END volume_z20,
 CASE WHEN ok_20 AND dollar_count_20=20 THEN amihud_20 END amihud_mean_20d,
 valid_60::smallint valid_close_count_61,NULL::integer source_age_seconds,now()built_at
 FROM eligible WHERE session_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end AND session_date>='2025-09-01' AND session_date<'2026-08-01'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.compute_daily_features_remediated_v1(p_lo integer, p_hi integer, p_start date DEFAULT '2025-09-01'::date, p_end date DEFAULT '2026-07-31'::date)

 WHERE session_date<'2025-09-01'
), cal AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT *,lag(session_date)OVER(ORDER BY session_date) previous_session_date FROM calendar

 SELECT instrument_key FROM reference.alpaca_fixed_window_instruments_v1

), actions AS MATERIALIZED (

), raw AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT u.instrument_key,c.session_date,c.regular_close,
 ((extract(epoch FROM c.regular_close-c.regular_open))/60)::smallint expected_bars,
 CASE WHEN d.instrument_key IS NOT NULL OR p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END::smallint source_code,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.bar_count WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.bar_count ELSE d.bar_count END::smallint observed_bars,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.close WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.close ELSE d.close END raw_close,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.volume WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.volume ELSE d.volume END raw_volume,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' THEN w.dollar_volume WHEN p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN p.dollar_volume ELSE d.dollar_volume END dollar_volume,
 greatest(d.source_observed_at,p.source_observed_at,w.source_observed_at,ir.source_acquired_at) source_observed_at,
 (p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL AND p.source_coverage_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'AVAILABLE') patch_unavailable,
 coalesce(d.instrument_key IS NOT NULL OR p.instrument_key IS NOT NULL OR w.instrument_key IS NOT NULL,false) source_present,
 CASE WHEN c.session_date<'2025-09-01' AND w.identity_state='CERTIFIED_EXACT_DATE_COMPOSITE_FIGI'
      THEN coalesce(nullif(w.provenance->>'share_class_figi',''),nullif(w.provenance->>'immutable_composite_figi',''))
      WHEN ir.instrument_key IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(nullif(ir.share_class_figi,''),nullif(ir.composite_figi,''))
      WHEN r.identity_certification_state='CERTIFIED_EXACT_DATE_COMPOSITE_AND_SHARE_FIGI_NATIVE_SOURCE_RECONCILED_V8'
      THEN coalesce(nullif(r.share_class_figi,''),nullif(r.composite_figi,''))
      WHEN st.n=1 AND st.strength='STRONG' THEN coalesce(nullif(st.share_class_figi,''),nullif(st.composite_figi,'')) END identity_anchor,
 coalesce(st.n,0)>1 identity_ambiguous,
 coalesce(a.split_log,0) split_log,coalesce(a.unknown_actions,0) unknown_actions,a.latest_knowledge
 FROM scope u CROSS JOIN cal c
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_daily_full_v2 d ON d.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND d.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_daily_calendar_patch_v8 p ON p.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND p.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_warmup_state_v38 w ON c.session_date<'2025-09-01' AND w.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND w.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN reference.equity_identity_day_overrides_remediation_v1 ir ON ir.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND ir.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.precursor_identity_day_reconciliation_v8 r ON r.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND r.session_date=c.session_date
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*)::int n,min(s.mapping_strength) strength,min(s.share_class_figi) share_class_figi,min(s.composite_figi) composite_figi
  FROM reference.equity_security_state_v1 s WHERE s.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND c.session_date>=s.valid_from AND c.session_date<s.valid_to)st ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT sum(ln(a.ratio_new_per_old::float8)) FILTER(WHERE a.ratio_new_per_old>0 AND a.ratio_new_per_old<1e20) split_log,
  count(*)FILTER(WHERE a.ratio_new_per_old IS NULL OR a.ratio_new_per_old<=0 OR a.ratio_new_per_old>=1e20 OR a.ratio_known_at IS NULL OR a.quality_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'PRIMARY_SHARE_REBASING_SEMANTICS_VERIFIED') unknown_actions,
  max(a.ratio_known_at)latest_knowledge
  FROM actions a WHERE a.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND a.execution_date>coalesce(c.previous_session_date,c.session_date-1) AND a.execution_date<=c.session_date)a ON true
), normalized AS (
 SELECT *,sum(split_log)OVER(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date) prefix_split_log,

 SELECT *,CASE WHEN close_valid AND lag(close_valid)OVER wi THEN raw_close/lag(raw_close)OVER wi-1 END raw_return,

 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e5 unknown_5,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e5 known_5,

 min(identity_anchor)OVER w21 min_id_20,max(identity_anchor)OVER w21 max_id_20,
 lag(adjusted_close_candidate,20)OVER wi lag_20,
 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e20 unknown_20,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e20 known_20,
 count(raw_close)FILTER(WHERE close_valid AND identity_anchor IS NOT NULL)OVER w61 valid_60,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER w61 min_id_60,max(identity_anchor)OVER w61 max_id_60,
 lag(adjusted_close_candidate,60)OVER wi lag_60,
 sum(unknown_actions)OVER e60 unknown_60,max(latest_knowledge)OVER e60 known_60,
 max(source_observed_at)OVER w61 dependency_observed_at,
 count(adjusted_log_return)OVER e20 log_count_20,stddev_samp(adjusted_log_return)OVER e20 vol_20,
 count(adjusted_volume_candidate)OVER v20 volume_count_20,
 avg(adjusted_volume_candidate)OVER v20 mean_volume_20,stddev_samp(adjusted_volume_candidate)OVER v20 sd_volume_20,
 min(identity_anchor)OVER v20 min_id_v20,max(identity_anchor)OVER v20 max_id_v20,
 count(identity_anchor)OVER v20 id_count_v20,
 count(dollar_volume)FILTER(WHERE dollar_volume>0 AND dollar_volume<'Infinity'::float8 AND adjusted_log_return IS NOT NULL)OVER e20 dollar_count_20,
 avg(abs(exp(adjusted_log_return)-1)/nullif(dollar_volume,0))FILTER(WHERE dollar_volume>0 AND dollar_volume<'Infinity'::float8)OVER e20 amihud_20
 FROM daily WINDOW wi AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date),
w2 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e1 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 0 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w6 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e5 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w21 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e20 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w61 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
e60 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key ORDER BY session_date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),

), eligible AS (
 SELECT *,regular_close+interval '1 minute' assumed_available_at,
 (valid_1=2 AND min_id_1=max_id_1 AND unknown_1=0 AND coalesce(known_1<=regular_close+interval '1 minute',true)AND lag_1>0) ok_1,

 (CASE WHEN valid_60<61 THEN 128 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN unknown_1>0 OR known_1>assumed_available_at THEN 256 ELSE 0 END)+

 (CASE WHEN unknown_20>0 OR known_20>assumed_available_at THEN 1024 ELSE 0 END)+

 raw_return,
 CASE WHEN ok_1 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_1-1 END ret_1d,
 CASE WHEN ok_5 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_5-1 END ret_5d,
 CASE WHEN ok_20 THEN adjusted_close_candidate/lag_20-1 END ret_20d,
